draws.note: draws are estimates; in the swap scene some civic planting is baked into shared batches (Latch 075), so today's draw count per piece is not known here
draws.per_unit_tufts: 92 instances x 2 submeshes (leaf, petal; C has no blooms: 1) = up to +184 forward draws without instancing, 6 with the GPU Resident Drawer; shadow the same again per cascade
draws.bed_level: 5 pieces x 3 submeshes = 15 forward draws, 10 shadow per cascade; one-off meshes, so no instancing needed

bedtuft.flag: Not 92 x 12k. The ~12k a bed is the testbed's per BED (its civic flowerBedRun beds), and we have 5 tufted beds: 45,239 triangles at the gameplay LOD for all five. Per unit, a testbed clump in the 0.62 m disc is 92-144 triangles at gameplay (638-680 at the top LOD), so 92 units are 11,678 at gameplay.
bedtuft.rings_match: Our five tufted bed-kerb rings are the testbed's own civic beds (civic-planting-layout flowerBedRun outlines), each moved rigidly: max vertex error < 1 mm (domes077.manifest.json civicBeds). So the bed-level composition is literally the testbed's planting of those beds, reproduced by its code to the triangle (gameplay counts equal the bake's, bakeLod).
bedtuft.per_unit_reads: Close up the per-unit clumps read as a planted bed, but on today's flat green bed-hedge fill, lower and with fewer flowers than the testbed's beds. At play zoom they read as a loose row of clumps along the ring. The same 3 variants repeat 30 times each, with random yaw. Acceptable as a stopgap, not the testbed's look.
bedtuft.bed_level_reads: The testbed's beds: a dense planted mass with a canopy row and tall coral/amber blooms, dark soil at the rim, no hedge slab. It matches the testbed column.
bedtuft.proposal_for_splice: Generator rule: a civic bed ring (bed-kerb) is planted by one bed-level composition (cafe-garden-composition with the bed's flowerBedRun planting points: centre canopy row every 0.38 m, border rows every 0.30 m at (w/2 - wall) x 0.62-0.8, rounded-end points), not by BedTuft stations. The bed-hedge fill is dropped and soil sits 3 mm proud of the kerb top. Our five beds are the testbed's, so their compositions are those bakes (CivicBed_<bed>_TB). Any new ring gets a flowerBedRun-style point set from its outline. Cost: 45,239 triangles at gameplay for the five (vs 8,305 tufts + hedge today), 15 forward draws instead of up to 184.
bedtuft.recommend: Bed level. It's the testbed's own design, it reads continuous, and it trades about +33k triangles (<= +0.07 ms GPU) for about 170 fewer draws than per-unit tufts would add. Per-unit BedTuft_<v>_TB is built and rendered as asked.

leaf_shader.owner: Latch (shader code), Glint (look in the grade)
leaf_shader.found: DK Lit Cutaway's passes include URP's stock LitForwardPass / GBuffer / DepthNormals: no vertex colour and no back-face normal flip (unity/Assets/Suborned/Shaders/DecoKit/DK_LitCutaway.shader lines 198, 345, 449).
changes: Vertex colour: a shader_feature_local _DK_VERTEX_COLOR. Pass COLOR through Varyings and multiply albedo by color.rgb in the forward, GBuffer and Meta passes. The values are linear multipliers (three's), exported linear (FBX colors_type LINEAR); check Unity imports them unconverted. They carry the four leaf tints, root-to-tip occlusion and dark stems.

Back faces: leaf, petal and stem materials are Cull Off (testbed DoubleSide). In the forward, GBuffer and DepthNormals fragments, flip the world normal and the tangent frame for back faces (FRONT_FACE_SEMANTIC + IS_FRONT_VFACE), or the undersides light as if facing away. The shadow caster stays Cull Off.

Roughness: the testbed reads roughness = 0.49 (leaf) or 0.64 (petal) x ORM green. URP Lit wants smoothness in the metallic map's alpha, so derive a mask map at build time (A = 1 - k x ORM.g, same size, deterministic) or add a roughness-map keyword. Either is a format derivation, not a texture cut.
Normal scale 0.16 (_BumpScale), base colour #afbea1 on leaves, white on petals, soil maps on DK_Soil_TB (normal 0.4).
leaf_shader.setpass: One new keyword set (vertex colour + normal + mask + cull off) for leaf and petal: forward SetPass +1, shadow +1 (cull off). The lamps' chrome and opal can map onto the kit's existing DK_Chrome / DK_Lamp_Deco (0 new). Not measured.
leaf_shader.start_now: Can start in parallel: the candidate FBXs and the material spec are in out/decokit/troughs077/Models and briefs/077/troughs/metrics.json.
